_doc: Optional prop drop-ins. Add any of these PNGs to this folder and the engine draws them instead of the procedural prop, scaled into the listed world box (world is 440 x 820).

chest_lv1.png.use: Goal chamber chest, Lv.1 Dirt Alcove

chest_lv2.png.use: Goal chamber chest, Lv.2 Timber Chamber

chest_lv3.png.use: Goal chamber chest, Lv.3 Gold Treasury

acorn.png.use: Single acorn in the Free Cash pile and haulers' paws

frost_overlay.png.use: Window-pane frost drawn over the arched window during the Frostline
